description.value:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

These tiny edible treats not only delight the taste buds, but alter the body in strange and magnificent ways. Upon eating the fancies, you transform into a well-dressed Tiny animal for 10 minutes with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Pest Form], except you can talk while in this form and can't Dismiss the effect. To determine what kind of animal you're transformed into, roll [[/gmr 1d6]];

  1. A cat wearing a tuxedo and a top hat

  2. A dodo bird with a very large blue ribbon

  3. A hedgehog with tiny red boots and white gloves

  4. A dog wearing a deerstalker hat and an ulster coat

  5. A frog wearing a powdered white wig and a matching white jabot

  6. A goose wearing a wide-brimmed sun hat adorned with many flowers.
